name: com.files/python-mcp
description: Local-only Python MCP server for the Files.com API.

environmentVariables.description: Files.com API key used by the local MCP server to authenticate API requests.
environmentVariables.name: FILES_COM_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional absolute path to an existing local directory. Restricts uploads and downloads to that directory and its children. Omit or leave empty to allow any local path accessible to the server.
environmentVariables.name: FILES_COM_LOCAL_ROOT
